kapak.alt: The audiologist in law, and the limits

youtube.aciklama: In Türkiye, the audiologist is defined in clause (c) of Additional Article 13, added to Law No. 1219 by Law No. 6225 in 2011; so audiology became a health profession recognized by law. Under the same article, health professionals other than physicians and dentists cannot plan treatment by making a direct diagnosis and cannot write prescriptions; diagnosis, the treatment plan and prescriptions are the responsibility of physicians and dentists. So in a report, the audiologist describes the findings and what they are consistent with. This is not legal advice; check the current legislation.

bilgiler: In Türkiye, Additional Article 13 of Law No. 1219 defines the audiologist.
Professionals other than physicians and dentists cannot prescribe.
Direct diagnosis and the treatment plan are also the physician's responsibility.
